summary: The promise on day one: {the promise} can be kept at once, by order, minutes after the oath, or broken when the numbers turn.
realLife: One life: Minutes after his swearing-in as California governor in 2003, he signed an order repealing the tripled vehicle license fee, his main pledge. Another: After taking office as Detroit's mayor in 1974, he disbanded the police decoy unit he had campaigned against. Another: Elected in 1990 after saying he would not seek an income tax, he faced a large deficit, vetoed budgets without one, and signed a 6 percent income tax in 1991. Tens of thousands rallied against him, and he did not run again.
choices: keep it at once by order
